label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.9 a.1… supports A living thing whose life-state differs…
note: The q.9 a.1 claim reads a life-state differing between two times as a change of some kind (quocumque modo mutatur). The encoded bridge adds that such a change within one living subject is a being moved in the Physics III.1 sense, as alteration is; the claim does not state this, and it does not extend to generation or corruption, which Physics V counts as changes but not motions.
